project.name: Spatio-Temporal Graph Neural Networks for Misinformation Cascade Tracking

research_notes.source_localization: Structural rumor-centrality approximations only. UPFD does not provide verified human patient-zero labels.
research_notes.anomaly_isolation: Heuristic coordination and fanout metrics. Not verified ground-truth bot detections.
research_notes.temporal_quantiles: Chronological quantile cutoffs represent observed diffusion progress, not fixed-duration real-time streaming windows.
research_notes.explainable_ai: Feature-modality ablation and node-feature occlusion measure veracity prediction sensitivity. They do NOT prove real-world causality, bot status, or ground-truth source node identity.

calibration_protocol.fitted_on: validation split logits and labels strictly (zero test leakage)

score_definitions.brier_score_multiclass: Sum of MSE across both classes in [0, 2]
score_definitions.ece_positive_class: Marginal calibration of P(FAKE) over [0, 1] vs observed fake rate
score_definitions.ece_top_label: Confidence calibration of max_k P(k) over [0, 1] vs accuracy

protocol.selection_rule: Sequential first 10 held-out test cascades with complete timestamps (indices 0..9)
protocol.baseline_intervention: Zero-masking active node features with fixed graph topology
protocol.sign_convention: delta_p = baseline_probability - perturbed_probability. Positive values (>0) indicate confidence drop after masking (positive support).

methodological_guardrails.causality_disclaimer: Attribution scores quantify model prediction sensitivity under feature occlusion. They do NOT establish real-world causal responsibility or patient-zero identity.
methodological_guardrails.untrained_head_disclaimer: The STGNN auxiliary source_head was never trained and was not used in any calculation.
methodological_guardrails.sample_limitation: Evaluated on a deterministic 10-cascade sample from the held-out test split. Serves as an exploratory empirical investigation rather than a definitive whole-benchmark claim.

modality_attribution.score_interpretation: Ablation sensitivity (non-additive marginal probability shift, not causal importance)
